items.title: 主观策略股票私募加快引入AI，打破“AI只适配量化投资”固有观念
items.raw_excerpt: 当前，人工智能（AI）正深度融入资本市场投资环节，是私募行业转型升级的核心动力。从业内获悉，以往依靠深度调研、经验判断开展操作的主观策略股票私募，如今正加快引入AI技术，提升基金经理的资金管理半径与研究覆盖边界。不少主观策略私募已经打破“AI只适配量化投资”的固有观念。业内人士认为，AI在主观策略私募领域的渗透比例还会持续走高，既能赋能传统私募机构，甚至还将孕育出全新形态的私募主体。（证券时报）

title_i18n.zh: 主观策略股票私募加快引入AI，打破“AI只适配量化投资”固有观念
title_i18n.en: Subjective strategy stock private equity firms are accelerating the adoption of AI, breaking the entrenched notion that "AI is only suitable for quantitative investing."
title_i18n.es: Los fondos de inversión privados en acciones con estrategias subjetivas están acelerando la adopción de la IA, rompiendo la idea preconcebida de que "la IA solo se adapta a la inversión cuantitativa".

excerpt_i18n.zh: 当前，人工智能（AI）正深度融入资本市场投资环节，是私募行业转型升级的核心动力。从业内获悉，以往依靠深度调研、经验判断开展操作的主观策略股票私募，如今正加快引入AI技术，提升基金经理的资金管理半径与研究覆盖边界。不少主观策略私募已经打破“AI只适配量化投资”的固有观念。业内人士认为，AI在主观策略私募领域的渗透比例还会持续走高，既能赋能传统私募机构，甚至还将孕育出全新形态的私募主体。（证券时报）
excerpt_i18n.en: Currently, artificial intelligence (AI) is deeply integrating into the investment processes of capital markets, serving as a core driver for the transformation and upgrading of the private equity industry. According to industry sources, subjective strategy stock private equity firms, which previously relied on in-depth research and experience-based judgment for operations, are now accelerating the adoption of AI technology to enhance fund managers' capital management capacity and research coverage boundaries. Many subjective strategy private equity firms have already broken the traditional notion that "AI is only suitable for quantitative investing." Industry insiders believe that the penetration rate of AI in the subjective strategy private equity sector will continue to rise, not only empowering traditional private equity institutions but also potentially giving rise to entirely new forms of private equity entities. (Securities Times)
excerpt_i18n.es: Actualmente, la inteligencia artificial (IA) se está integrando profundamente en los procesos de inversión del mercado de capitales, convirtiéndose en el motor central de la transformación y actualización de la industria de fondos de inversión privados. Según información del sector, los fondos de inversión privados de estrategia subjetiva, que antes operaban basándose en investigaciones profundas y juicios empíricos, ahora están acelerando la adopción de tecnología de IA para ampliar el radio de gestión de capital y el alcance de investigación de los gestores de fondos. Muchos fondos de estrategia subjetiva ya han superado la idea preconcebida de que "la IA solo es adecuada para la inversión cuantitativa". Los expertos del sector consideran que la penetración de la IA en el ámbito de los fondos de estrategia subjetiva seguirá aumentando, lo que no solo potenciará a las instituciones tradicionales de fondos privados, sino que incluso podría dar lugar a nuevas formas de entidades de fondos privados. (Securities Times)

That previous post showed how to implement FHE-based inference 'from scratch' by hand-crafting a linear-regression algorithm using a low-level library called SEAL. Instead, this post shows a much more flexible and higher-level approach based on concrete-ml, a high-level library built specifically for FHE-based inference. It supports several common types of models 'out of the box' and is even API compatible with the well-known ML library scikit-learn.

title_i18n.es: Inferencia de ML cifrada de extremo a extremo con Amazon SageMaker AI y FHE

excerpt_i18n.en: This blog has previously discussed FHE for ML inference in the post Enable fully homomorphic encryption with Amazon SageMaker endpoints for secure, real-time inferencing, but this post goes a little further. That previous post showed how to implement FHE-based inference 'from scratch' by hand-crafting a linear-regression algorithm using a low-level library called SEAL. Instead, this post shows a much more flexible and higher-level approach based on concrete-ml, a high-level library built specifically for FHE-based inference. It supports several common types of models 'out of the box' and is even API compatible with the well-known ML library scikit-learn.
